skill.name: signup-flow-cro
skill.description: Optimizes signup, registration, account creation, and trial activation flows to reduce friction and improve completion rates.
skill.summary: Audit signup flows and recommend CRO improvements for fields, trust, errors, mobile UX, and activation handoff.
skill.author: coreyhaines31

security_audit.summary: The two static system reconnaissance alerts are false positives from benign signup optimization guidance. The skill contains CRO advice for forms, authentication options, measurement, and experiment planning, with no evidence of malicious intent or prompt injection.

static_findings.snippet: - Show strength meter instead of rigid rules

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 17 lists paid account creation as a signup flow type to assess. It does not request host, network, identity, or environment reconnaissance.
Line 81 recommends a password strength meter for better user experience. This is product UX guidance, not system reconnaissance or credential collection.

content.value_statement: Signup flows often lose users through extra fields, unclear errors, and weak trust cues. This skill audits registration experiences and suggests focused CRO changes.
actual_capabilities: Assess signup flow type, required fields, and user drop-off context.
Recommend field reductions, progressive profiling, and smarter field order.
Improve password, social auth, phone, company, and role question UX.
Suggest mobile signup improvements for typing, layout, autofill, and touch targets.
Define measurement points for completion rate, errors, time, and step progression.
Generate experiment ideas for layout, copy, trust elements, trials, and verification.
limitations: It needs current funnel data to estimate impact with confidence.
It does not replace legal review for compliance or consent requirements.
It cannot validate analytics accuracy without access to tracking implementation.
It focuses on signup and registration, not full post-signup onboarding.

use_cases.title: Improve SaaS Trial Signup
use_cases.description: Find high-friction fields, improve trial copy, and suggest tests for a B2B SaaS registration flow.

use_cases.title: Simplify Consumer App Registration
use_cases.description: Reduce typing, improve mobile form behavior, and evaluate social auth placement for a consumer product.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Account Creation Drop-Off
use_cases.description: Review funnel steps, field errors, and verification requirements to prioritize conversion fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Signup Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this signup flow: [describe screens, fields, and CTA]. Identify friction points and quick wins.

prompt_templates.title: Field Reduction Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these required signup fields: [list fields]. Tell me which fields to keep, defer, make optional, or remove.

prompt_templates.title: Drop-Off Diagnosis
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this funnel data: [paste step completion, error rates, device split]. Prioritize signup fixes by likely impact and effort.

prompt_templates.title: Experiment Roadmap
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced testing plan for a product team
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a signup CRO test roadmap for [product type]. Include hypotheses, variants, metrics, segments, and rollout order.

output_examples.input: Audit a B2B SaaS trial signup with email, password, name, company, phone, and role required.
output_examples.output: High priority: remove or defer phone and role until onboarding. Keep email and password first. Test company as optional and explain why it helps setup.

output_examples.input: Suggest mobile improvements for a consumer app registration screen.
output_examples.output: Use one column, email keyboard type, autofill, larger touch targets, visible labels, and social auth above the email form.

output_examples.input: Plan A/B tests for a trial signup page with weak completion rates.
output_examples.output: Start with field reduction, clearer trial copy, no-credit-card messaging, social auth placement, and delayed email verification.

best_practices: Start with the minimum fields needed before the user can reach product value.
Use funnel and field-level data to prioritize changes by impact and effort.
Pair form changes with clear trust copy, error recovery, and mobile testing.
anti_patterns: Do not require nice-to-have profile data before the first product experience.
Do not hide password rules until after a failed submission.
Do not add verification, CAPTCHA, or phone requirements without measuring conversion cost.

faq.question: What signup flows does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports free trial, freemium, paid account, waitlist, B2B, B2C, and e-commerce account creation flows.

faq.question: Can it redesign a complete signup form?
faq.answer: Yes. It can recommend fields, field order, labels, button copy, error text, and layout changes.

faq.question: Does it handle post-signup onboarding?
faq.answer: Only the handoff after submission. A dedicated onboarding skill is better for activation flows after account creation.

faq.question: What data improves the recommendations?
faq.answer: Completion rate, step drop-off, field error rate, device split, time to complete, and current field requirements help most.

faq.question: Can it create A/B test ideas?
faq.answer: Yes. It suggests tests for fields, layout, social auth, trust copy, verification, trial terms, and post-submit messaging.

faq.question: Will it guarantee higher conversion rates?
faq.answer: No. It provides evidence-based hypotheses that should be tested with real traffic and reliable analytics.
